Struct ShapeHandle<T>

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry

ShapeEngine.dll

A lightweight, readonly handle that wraps a non-null shape instance of type T.

public readonly struct ShapeHandle<T> where T : IShapeTypeProvider

Type Parameters

T

The concrete shape type. Must be non-nullable. Supports: Segment, Line, Ray, Circle Triangle, Rect, Quad, Polygon, Polyline

Remarks

Exposes the wrapped value via Value and a cached ShapeType. Provides fast type-aware accessors (TryGet) for the underlying shape.

Remarks

Exposes the wrapped value via Value and a cached ShapeType. Provides fast type-aware accessors (TryGet) for the underlying shape.

Fields

ShapeType

The cached ShapeType corresponding to the wrapped shape instance.

public readonly ShapeType ShapeType

Field Value

ShapeType

Remarks

Computed at construction from value.GetShapeType() and stored to enable fast, allocation-free type checks used by the TryGet* accessors.

Value

The wrapped shape instance. Guaranteed to be non-null.

public readonly T Value

Field Value

T

Remarks

Initialized from the primary constructor parameter. An ArgumentNullException is thrown if a null value is supplied. This field is readonly; use Value to access the underlying shape.

TryGet<TU>(out TU)

Attempts to retrieve the wrapped value as the specified shape type TU.

public bool TryGet<TU>(out TU shape) where TU : IShapeTypeProvider

Parameters

shape TU

On success contains the unwrapped instance of TU; otherwise the default value.

Returns

bool

True if the wrapped value is an instance of TU and was assigned to shape; otherwise false.

Type Parameters

TU

The target concrete shape type implementing IShapeTypeProvider.

Remarks

Performs a runtime type-check and assignment. Prefer the specific TryGet* helpers when the cached ShapeType can be used for faster, allocation-free checks.
